description: This is a controller class for handling language selection and saving language preferences in the Opencart admin panel. It loads available languages, manages language cookies, and redirects accordingly.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language selection and preferences in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads available languages, determines current language, and prepares data for the language selection view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the selected language into a cookie, validates language code, and manages redirection after selection.
